The '''2023 Supercopa de España''' was the 39th edition of the [[Supercopa de España]], an annual [[Association football|football]] competition for clubs in the [[Spanish football league system]] that were successful in its major competitions in the preceding season.

[[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] won the tournament for their record-extending fourteenth Supercopa de España title.

==Qualification==
The tournament featured the winners and runners-up of the [[2021–22 Copa del Rey]] and [[2021–22 La Liga]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rfef.es/sites/default/files/pdf/betting_in_english_0.pdf|title=Supercopa de España|website=www.rfef.es|access-date=13 January 2022}}</ref>

==Venue==
All three matches were held at the [[King Fahd International Stadium]] in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://rfef.es/es/noticias/oficial-definido-el-orden-de-partidos-de-la-supercopa-de-espana|title=OFICIAL {{!}} Definido el orden de partidos de la Supercopa de España|publisher=RFEF|language=es|date=4 November 2022|access-date=4 November 2022}}</ref>
